evaluation_status: Previously exposed development seeds, not a blind final test
states: Five evenly spaced post-warmup snapshots per training/selection/calibration seed; all nine post-warmup snapshots per evaluation seed
blocks: First eight graph-priority blocks plus four evenly spaced remaining blocks, without replacement; no outcome-based selection
collector: Frozen verified-prefix teacher: width16, shortlist48, per_parent2; incumbent suffix completion; no acceptance changes to archived trajectories
candidate_population: All shortlisted occurrences at each teacher prefix depth; canonical unique full actions per block for primary cost-recall curves
target_scope: One-step physical risk proxy, not PAV future-success advantage or native packet delivery
inputs: Causal cached actor features; actor likelihood and depth; optional cheap full-TB and activity-trace summaries. No candidate exact values, future packet outcomes or exact parent score as model inputs
selection: Choose architecture and epoch using selection-seed macro per-block top-decile recall at 10% unique-candidate budget; tie: lower exact best-score regret, then earlier epoch. Calibration/evaluation labels never used for selection
high_yield_definition: All guard-eligible unique candidates with positive root-relative R gain in the highest decile of eligible gains, including ties; report both recall of this set and probability of retaining any member
guards: Same-state exact J > root J+16, R > root R+1, dequeue >= ceil(.90*own PFQ+CTBS draft dequeue)
gate: At 10% unique-candidate evaluation budget, high-yield recall >=95% separately on both development evaluation seeds; this is an offline necessary screen, not closed-loop noninferiority
calibration: Empirical one-sided standardized residual threshold on seed45 only, plus honest seed-cluster split-conformal feasibility diagnostic; alpha .02, calibration seed count1, finite distribution-free seed-level bound unavailable
accounting: Report label-collection PHY calls/time, deduplicated candidate curves, root setup evaluations, feature+head runtime separately. Curves on a frozen teacher pool do not establish end-to-end search savings
future_closed_loop: Only after offline screen: freeze design and new seeds311-315, each>=5s, loads1.0/1.2/1.4/1.6, compare physical rho.90 with payload>=99.5%, expiry delta<=.1pp, mean/P95 delay<=control, UE P5>=control and a predeclared UE-regression-count limit
